cards.claim: Astrid de Groot has been listed on the focus list for WikiProject Badminton.
cards.quote: As she delved deeper into the WikiProject Badminton\/tournament focus list, she was impressed by the dedication of its contributors. There was RacketRanger, a self-proclaimed "badminton enthusiast" from Malaysia, and "ShuttleShifter," a statistician from Denmark who had compiled an exhaustive database of tournament results. As Astrid began to engage with the community, she realized that her own experiences as a politician could inform and enrich the project. Her knowledge of international relations and event management could help the team refine their tournament coverage. And so, she started contributing, her insights and suggestions earning her a spot on the focus list.

cards.claim: Astrid de Groot has been listed on the focus list for the Wikimedia project NL Gendergap maintenance.
cards.quote: Astrid de Groot is featured on the focus list of the Wikimedia project NL Gendergap maintenance, a Dutch-language project aimed at bridging the gender gap on Wikipedia.
